ledger.credibility: Management frequently guides clearly and hits customer addition targets, such as reaching 119.3 million customers in FY26. However, they sometimes miss specific growth targets like MSME or FY26 AUM growth, and occasionally drop or stop mentioning unfulfilled tech and cost targets.
bull: Net profit compounded at 34.3% over five years, supported by trailing net profit of ₹22,066 cr on revenue of ₹90,331 cr.
Customer franchise successfully expanded to 119.33 million in FY2026, hitting customer addition goals of 17.5 million new users.
Fee income growth is on track at 20.7%, aligning with medium-term guidance of 20% to 25% growth.
bear: FY26 AUM growth missed expectations, coming in at 18.1% against a targeted 22-23%.
Gold loan branch expansion is slipping, reaching only 2,022 branches compared to the year-end target of 2,700 to 2,800 branches.
Management frequently drops unfulfilled operational and technology targets, such as abandoning the 80 FinAI areas plan.
